body:
## Cash-only model block

Sector Q is currently treated as a model block and available on cash rather than an installment plan. Ask for the latest written payable amount for the exact plot you are considering.

Do not compare the cash figure directly with an installment option without checking the total payable amount, payment timing and any location premium.

## Sector Q plan and plot position

Use the dedicated Sector Q plan to locate the exact property inside the model block. Compare plot number, road width, corner status, nearby open space and access before you shortlist.

The plan is a layout reference, not a live stock list. Ask for the exact available plot marked on the plan.

## Road position and premium locations

Plots on a main road, corner, park/open-space edge or other preferred position can carry additional charges. Compare two plots of the same size by exact location, not by size alone.

## Development and site check

Check the current road condition, plot demarcation and surrounding activity at the exact location. A site visit or current live video is more useful than relying on an old promotional image.

## Before you pay

Confirm the plot number, seller or booking position, dues, special-location charges, payment recipient and receipt process. Keep the latest written payable amount for the exact property.
